events.text: In the Year of the Dancing Piper, 352 DR, a fire swept through Alaghôn's shipyards and granaries, thus crippling Turmish's navy and destroying its food stores, causing a rise in piracy and widespread famine.
Cormyr and Valashar warred over claims to the northern and western areas of Cormyr.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 71

events.text: The armies of Valashar were crushed by the armies of Cormyr at the Fields of the Dead.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 71

events.text: The armies of Cormyr continued on to sack several garrisons and the city of Ithmong.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 71

events.text: The red dragon Garnetallisar was granted permission to live within the city, due to its unique benevolent nature.
cites: Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 127

events.text: Cormyr and the Shoon Imperium decided to extend their influence into the Western Heartlands.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 71

events.text: After succumbing to heartstop, King Darthorn II died. His eldest son and namesake, Darthorn III took over the mantle of king.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 79

events.text: A convoy of colony ship departed from Calimshan with the goal to colonize the Moonshaes. A massive storm sunk half the fleet and knocked the remaining ships far off course.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23–31

events.text: The prayerbane plague spread across of realm of Impiltur and ravaged its populace. Among the dead were Queen Shardra and Crown-prince Thoraven. Overwhelmed with grief and despair, King Darthorn III commit suicide by drowning. After losing both parents along with his elder brother in a single year, Auminath I ascended to the throne of the kingdom.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 79

events.text: The army of Cormyr attacked the army of Shoon Imperium, driving it back through Amn, Tethyr, and Valashar before sacking Ithmong and returning to Cormyr.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 72

events.text: In 376 DR, Cormyr wiped out the army of Valashar in a great battle on the Fields of the Dead before marching into Tethyr and sacking the city of Ithmong.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Tethyr, с. 30
Lands of Intrigue: Amn, с. 20
Empires of the Shining Sea, с. 31

events.text: Seven powerful mages formed the first wizard school that was open to all races whose teachers were not exclusively elves, known as the Incanistaeum. These mages came to be known as the Seven Wizards of Myth Drannor outside the city.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 39

events.text: In the Year of the Quelzarn, 383 DR, hin established Ammathluir along the trade road into Luiren.
The city of Hazuth is founded in eastern Dambrath
cites: Shining South, с. 103

events.text: The city's mythal was assaulted by a contingent of five black dragons and two green dragons. They were ultimately destroyed by Itham, commander of the dragonriders, though at the cost of his life, that of a bronze dragon, along with fifty hippogriffs and their riders.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 39
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 73

events.text: Circa 400 DR, small bands of goblins and orcs were making incursions into Turmish and establishing territories; Turmish was kept so busy fighting it was unable to send aid to the cities of Chondathian and Chauncelgaunt in later Sembia when they called.

In the Year of the Blue Shield, 400 DR, on a night that came to be known as the First Turnabout, the Dark Alliance assaulted and destroyed Northkeep from black-sailed ships in the Sea of Dragons, as well as mounted upon the backs of black dragons.
The Thunder Peaks Routing was a fifteen-year armed conflict between goblinoids of the Thunder Peaks and the cities of Saerloon and Selgaunt that started in 400 DR.

The Eye Battles were a long-running series of skirmishes, invasions, and rebellions fought between the beholder tyrants of the Alimir Mountains and their subjects in the Lake of Steam region and the Shoon Imperium in the 5th century DR.
The Wandering War begins between several Arkaiun tribes vying for territory
cites: Shining South, с. 103

events.text: The Mage Purges was a bloody and destructive campaign of wizard-killing perpetuated by Emperor Amahl Shoon VII between 427 DR and his death in 450 DR.
Duar Obarskyr set off to defeat an orc army in the King's Forest.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 73

events.text: While Duar Obarskyr was away, Melineth Turcassan sold the city of Suzail to Magrath the Minotaur for five hundred sacks of gold.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 73

events.text: In the Year of the Cat's Eye, 429 DR the Chondathan mercenary captain Mulsantir Illistine attacked Westgate and overthrew the pirate kings.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 85

events.text: By the Year of the Sea Princes, 432 DR, many noble families had left Cormyr for either the Dalelands or Waterdeep, or split into small factional bands.
Duar Obarskyr defeated Magrath the Minotaur.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 73

events.text: The Seven Burnings was a short war of rebellion followed by devastating reprisals in the Shoon Imperium colonies of the Shaar region in the 5th century DR.
The Night of Dark Fire marked the death of Gorothir, the infamous Sharran high priest known as the Dark Prophet of the Night.

The Shoonach Conflagration, or the Great Fires of Shoonach, was the intentional arson and destruction of Shoonach's Imperial City, capital of the Shoon Imperium, at the hand of Prince Strohm of Tethyr.
Crimmor became part of the country of Amn, under the reign of King Esmel Torlath.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 88

events.text: The coronal placed moratorium on the creation of new homes and no more non-elves were permitted to make their residence in Myth Drannor.
cites: Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 127
Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 128

events.text: In the Year of the Eclipsed Heart, 464 DR, the first human ever was granted admittance into Evereska.
The Giant wereape Dermos the Proud develops a fanatical cult, claiming to be the gold Malar. He orders that all he Arkaiun people be killed
cites: Shining South, с. 103

events.text: A large group of immigrants from Tethyr arrived on the islands and settled among the Ffolk. The newly arrived Tethyrians brought their religious beliefs with them, but most Ffolk maintained their faith in the Earthmother. Architects and engineers among the immigrants shared their knowledge with the Ffolk, allowing the Ffolk to construct improved defensive fortifications. As a result, raids from Northlanders dropped over the next few centuries.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23–31

events.text: Dermos, and all of his followers were slain during an ambush at Blackrock Ridge
cites: Shining South, с. 103

events.text: In the Year of Full Cellars, 472 DR the Chondathan city of Mussum was hit by a mysterious plague, which killed more than three quarters of the population in less than a day, and the city was abandoned.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 88

events.text: The Eve of the Panicked Plague was the name given to the disaster that raged in Chondath for a single night in 472 DR.

During the Ogre Wars, Prince Imnel Torlath and his armies fought on the Small Teeth to restore trade between Crimmor and Murann. The town of Imnescar would later be founded where that battle took place.

events.text: In 491 DR, a powerful Calishite nobleman, Kadar el Aktorral, founded the kingdom of Cortryn, gathering Tethyrian and Calishite immigrants and absorbing most of Meiritin, along with its neighbor Valashar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 89
